Tonderfest_regions <- read_csv2("Tonder_festival_region.csv") %>% 
  select(-Index)

## Rows: 51 Columns: 5── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Delimiter: ";"
## chr (4): Nationalitet, All_Regions, America_Canada, Atlantic_Other

## Rows: 51
## Columns: 4
## $ Nationalitet   <chr> NA, "GB", "SCO", "CAN", "DK", "IRL", "NL", "USA", "D", …
## $ All_Regions    <chr> NA, "Atlantic", "Atlantic", "North America", "DK", "Atl…
## $ America_Canada <chr> NA, "Atlantic", "Atlantic", "North America", "DK", "Atl…
## $ Atlantic_Other <chr> NA, "Atlantic", "Atlantic", "Atlantic", "DK", "Atlantic…
# Remove index column

# Merge the region column onto the Tonder_fest tibble
Tonder_merged <- merge(Tonder_fest, Tonderfest_regions, by.x = "Nationalitet") %>%
  arrange(År)
head(Tonder_merged)

##   Atlantic_Other
## 1       Atlantic
## 2             DK

## 4             DK
## 5             DK
## 6             DK
# group by nationality, year and region
Tonder_grouped <- Tonder_merged %>% 
  group_by(Nationalitet,År,All_Regions) %>% 
  tally() %>% 
  arrange(År,All_Regions)

# Group with 
Tonder_grouped1 <- Tonder_merged %>% 
  group_by(Nationalitet, År, America_Canada) %>% 
  tally() %>% 
  arrange(År, America_Canada)

Tonder_grouped2 <- Tonder_merged %>% 
  group_by(Nationalitet, År, Atlantic_Other) %>% 
  tally() %>% 
  arrange(År, Atlantic_Other)

# First we plot the total number of nationalities by each year
Tonder_total_nationalities <- Tonder_fest %>% 
  group_by(År) %>% 
  tally()
glimpse(Tonder_total_nationalities)
## Rows: 51
## Columns: 2
## $ År <dbl> 1974, 1975, 1976, 1977, 1978, 1979, 1980, 1981, 1982, 1983, 1984, 1…
## $ n  <int> 13, 20, 22, 25, 34, 28, 37, 47, 46, 42, 51, 46, 43, 44, 40, 38, 41,…
ggplot(Tonder_total_nationalities, aes(År,n))+
  geom_point()+
  labs(title= "Total number of nationalities at Tønder Festival by year, 1974-2025",x = "Year", y = "Number of Nationalities")

# Then we plot the total number of artists by each year
Tonder_artist <- Tonder_fest %>% 
  na.omit(,Navn) %>% 
  group_by(År) %>% 
  tally

glimpse(Tonder_artist)

## Columns: 2

  labs(title = "Total number of artists at Tønder Festival by year, 1974-2025", x = "Year", y = "Number of Artists")

# Plot Again
# Error from the use of character 'Å' in variable 'År', so we change it to English
colnames(Tonder_long_lat)[2] <- "Year"
colnames(Tonder_long_lat1)[2] <- "Year"
colnames(Tonder_long_lat2)[2] <- "Year"

anim3 <- ggplot(Tonder_long_lat, aes(Longitude, Latitude, size = n, label = Nationalitet)) +
  geom_text(check_overlap=TRUE,aes(color=All_Regions)) +
  transition_time(Year)+
  labs(title = "{round({frame_time})}", x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude", color = "Region", size = "Number of\nartists at\nTønder Festival")

animate(anim3 + transition_time(Year), fps = 3)

# The Tonder_long_lat tibble has a lot of cloned values, and we haven't had the time to figure out why. We warn against using the animated map as more than a quick overview, and suggest using the other graphs instead.
#DK US GB
ggplot(Tonder_long_lat[Tonder_long_lat$Nationalitet %in% c("DK","US","GB"),],aes(Year,n))+
  geom_point(aes(color=Nationalitet))+
  labs(title = "Countries", x = "Year", y = "Number of artists at Tønder festival", color = "Country")

#GB DK Scotland
ggplot(Tonder_long_lat[Tonder_long_lat$Nationalitet %in% c("DK","GB","IE"),],aes(Year,n))+
  geom_smooth(aes(color=Nationalitet))+
  labs(title = "Countries", x = "Year", y = "Number of artists at Tønder festival", color = "Country")
## `geom_smooth()` using method = 'loess' and formula = 'y ~ x'

colnames(Tonder_long_lat)[6] <- "ISO_ALPHA_3"

# I want to sum n of all the countries in each region
# After searching high and low on Google I finally found som code that does what I want

# Found this code at https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/r-language/how-to-calculate-the-sum-by-group-in-r/
library(dplyr) 

Region_sums = Tonder_long_lat %>%                                       
  group_by(All_Regions,Year) %>%
  summarise_at(vars(n),
               list(name = sum))

Region_sums1 <- Tonder_long_lat1 %>% 
  group_by(America_Canada, Year) %>% 
  summarise_at(vars(n),
               list(name = sum))

Region_sums2 <- Tonder_long_lat2 %>% 
  group_by(Atlantic_Other, Year) %>% 
  summarise_at(vars(n),
               list(name = sum))

#Now I can plot it!

ggplot(Region_sums[Region_sums$All_Regions %in% c("Atlantic","DK","North America"),],aes(Year,name))+
  geom_point(aes(color=All_Regions))+
  labs(title = "Region", x = "Year", y = "Number of artists at Tønder festival", color = "Region")

#Atlantic, North America and DK

ggplot(Region_sums2[Region_sums2$Atlantic_Other %in% c("DK","Atlantic","Other"),],aes(Year,name))+
  geom_point(aes(color=Atlantic_Other))+
  labs(title = "Region", x = "Year", y = "Number of artists at Tønder festival", color = "Region")

  tally()

#Creating a column with the total number of nationalities within the given year
Tonder_n_sum <- merge(Tonder_regions_sum,Tonder_total_nationalities, by = "År")

#Calculating the percentage of any given nationality in the given year
Tonder_n_sum1 <- mutate(Tonder_n_sum, "n_total_n" = n / total_n)

Region_n_sum1 = Tonder_n_sum1 %>%                                       
  group_by(America_Canada,År) %>%
  summarise_at(vars("n_total_n"),
               list("n_total_n" = sum)) %>% 
  arrange(År)

ggplot(Region_n_sum1, aes(x = År, y = n_total_n))+
  geom_point(aes(colour=America_Canada))+
  labs(x= "Year", y= "Nationalities as a percentage of the total number of nationalities", title = "Nationalities by percentage, 1974-2025")

glimpse(Region_n_sum1)
